title: Personal Sender Account Level Points on Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credits
content:
Account level benefits table: **Mobile Wallet** shortfall re-credits carry level points according to the customer's Personal Sender Account level.

| Personal Sender Account level | Level points on a shortfall re-credit |
|---|---|
| Paloma Enhanced or higher (level number 4 or more) | 0.30 |
| Paloma Verified Plus (level number 3) | 0.15 |
| a lower level | nothing |

The level is the one the customer's Personal Sender Account holds at the time of the re-credit.

*Hypothetical cases:* a Paloma Verified Plus account earns 0.15 points; a Paloma Enhanced account earns 0.30 points; a Paloma Verified or Paloma Starter account earns nothing.
